walkthroughs.body_html:
Linear search of 1,000,000 items: up to 1,000,000 checks (O(n)).

Binary search of the same sorted list: about 20 checks (O(log n)) because each step halves the search space.
For linear search the worst case is the item being at the end (or missing). For bubble sort it is a list sorted in reverse — every pair must swap.
Unsorted list, tiny size? Linear search is fine. Sorted list, huge size? Binary search wins. Always weigh setup cost (sorting) against query cost.
